# P06 Causes and hypotheses

- Requirement: Required for bug investigations. A confirmed cause is not required; an unknown cause is allowed. Optional for other types
- Placement: The relevant discussion in the body
- Narrative role: Explains which interpretation the observations support and what remains unconfirmed.
- Author: Investigator
- Reviewer: Owner on the team responsible for the relevant code, data or operational path
- Check: Are observed symptoms separated from causal inference? Is there a way to confirm or reject the hypothesis?

<!-- body:start -->
## Current interpretation and remaining hypotheses

The current cause is [confirmed information or unknown]. [Suspected cause] may explain [observed phenomenon], but [unchecked conditions or other possible causes] remain.

[Owner of the area] can assess this hypothesis by checking with [investigation method]. If [result] occurs, revise the interpretation and recheck [affected requests, behavior or completion conditions]. Do not invent content just because the cause is not yet known.
<!-- body:end -->
